quote: Crowdsourced workers are asked to determine the agreement between two annotation pairs constructed from three annotators, that is, A: (e 1 , e 2 ) and B: (e 1 , e 3 ). They choose between three options: (1) A has higher agreement than B; (2) A and B have (roughly) the same agreement; and (3) B has higher agreement than A.
